summary: After a layoff, nearly one in five long-tenured workers is still looking and about one in six has stopped looking altogether.
realLife: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that about 18 percent of long-tenured displaced workers were still unemployed and about 16 percent had left the labor force.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Worker Displacement news release: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/disp.nr0.htm
inGame: job record has no current employer after job-ended event; a person with no job record and no search is the stopped-looking case.

turns.summary: The worker keeps applying and takes a poor-fit job at month eight.
The worker enrolls in a course instead of searching.
The worker stops searching and leans on relatives.
turns.writesBack: relative tie closer, a promise to repay; journal note
